name: Button / IconButton
reason: Consistent reusable interaction pattern, low app coupling after removing styled-components/theme dependencies, strong showcase value.

name: Panel
reason: Clean typed surface and useful layout primitive with minimal coupling.

name: DisplayTitle / Callout
reason: High-level screen title and contextual message patterns adapted into package-level typography and callout components.

name: StatTile
reason: Portable metrics component that works well in portfolio, dashboard, and game HUD contexts.

name: OverlayActionDock
reason: Strong reusable action grouping pattern, refined to depend only on the shared Button.

name: EmptyState
reason: Reusable content-state pattern after replacing app theme tokens with package CSS variables.

name: LibraryCard
reason: Good reusable selection/list card pattern, refined away from styled-components and dense app-only behavior.

name: LibraryToolbar / SearchInput / FilterChip / SegmentedControl
reason: Reusable library browsing controls adapted into plain React primitives for public component and preset catalogs.

name: TextureKit
reason: Texture creator concepts rebuilt as palette, preview tile, and preset card primitives with no app theme or canvas dependency.

name: MusicWorkspace controls
reason: Beat-editor control patterns converted into transport, level meter, step grid, and mini timeline primitives.

name: AeroLiquidBackground
reason: Distinctive WebGL background component adapted for public showcase use with a CSS fallback.

name: ModalDialog
reason: Reusable focus-managed modal behavior rebuilt without styled-components or app theme coupling.

name: InstrumentPicker
reason: Instrument layer selection panel generalized into a reusable picker for layers, devices, and presets.

name: GameHud
reason: Game HUD patterns converted into generic overlay, resource, inventory, and control-hint primitives.

name: PreviewCard
reason: Older listing/card patterns rebuilt as a clean generic preview card for products, rentals, projects, and media.

name: FlipTile
reason: Memory-card flip behavior converted into a controlled CSS-transform button component without Redux or image assets.

name: Torch
reason: Self-contained R3F primitive with strong visual demo value and no physics/runtime asset coupling.

name: Brazier
reason: Scene prop adapted into a dependency-light R3F primitive with no Rapier requirement.

name: FirstPersonHand / HeldItemAnchor
reason: Original first-person hand idea rebuilt as a simple geometry primitive without Rapier, app input, or scene traversal coupling.

name: SceneControls
reason: Door, lever, and plate interactions converted into self-contained R3F geometry props.

name: DungeonProps
reason: Dungeon scene prop ideas rebuilt as dependency-light R3F primitives without Rapier, drei Text, or texture loaders.

name: TrapAndEffects
reason: Hazard and particle patterns adapted into simple primitive geometry and generated buffer particles.

name: EnvironmentProps
reason: Reusable environment prop concepts rebuilt as lightweight geometry-only R3F primitives.

name: ItemOrb
reason: Floating item/rarity presentation rebuilt without drei Text or app item types.

name: IconGlyph
reason: Reusable app/editor icon language rebuilt as typed SVG glyphs with no external icon package dependency.

name: TagEditor / SelectionCheckbox
reason: Library metadata and batch-selection patterns rebuilt without styled-components, anchored popovers, or app theme coupling.

name: InstrumentControls
reason: Musical input ideas converted into dependency-light visual controls that leave audio wiring to the host app.

name: SpellcasterHud
reason: Distinctive game HUD language extracted into regular DOM primitives for use over canvas or app screens.

name: ProjectileEffects
reason: Projectile effect language rebuilt as lightweight R3F geometry without Rapier, custom shader, or gameplay store coupling.

name: MemoryDungeonKit
reason: Memory-card, relic-choice, and HUD patterns rebuilt as plain React/CSS showcase components without game state, assets, Pixi, or WebGL coupling.

name: DungeonMapPanel
reason: Generated dungeon map overlay rebuilt as a typed, store-free React/CSS component with reusable room, route, current, visited, and locked states.

name: DeviceRackPanel
reason: Plugin rack presentation rebuilt as a typed React/CSS device-chain component without WAM runtime, styled-components, stores, or automation write coupling.

name: Chest / breakable object primitives
reason: Original implementation depends on Rapier, drei Text, texture loaders, and local breakable wrappers; needs a separate lightweight rewrite before inclusion.

name: CatCard / picture slider
reason: Useful archive material, but implementation is tightly coupled to Angular routing/local state and dated Bootstrap/jQuery carousel patterns.

name: RvPreview / SearchBar
reason: Small and reusable after cleanup, but less visually distinctive than the accepted first-pass components.

name: ProductCard
reason: Archive component with route/service coupling and old class component shape; not strong enough for strict showcase inclusion.
